data.body: Split landed as Gerrit change 1382 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1382). Pure mechanical move of the completion-precheck cluster (_is_live_ticket, _has_live_replacement_link, _referencing_commit_exists, _completion_precheck) into new close_precheck.py; transition_close.py 803->491 LOC, close_precheck.py 346 LOC. Moved bodies verbatim-identical to origin/main; re-export seam preserves monkeypatch targets and _referencing_commit_exists direct import. Lint+mypy clean, 483 pinned close-gate/lifecycle tests pass with zero test-file edits. Rebuilt on a fresh origin/main worktree after the crash left the WIP stranded on the wrong base (fix/1019 @ the 4522 commit). Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1; not closing until CI is green.
